notes.title: Putty Pals 1.3 Update + Nintendo Switch Release Date
notes.content:
[h1][b]We have an exciting announcement Pals! 📢[/b][/h1]

[b][i]Putty Pals[/i] will be releasing on the Nintendo Switch™ on the 18th (US) & 19th (AUS/EU) of October! 😱[/b]

And for our beloved Steam players…. Don’t worry, we haven’t forgotten about you! 🤗 

We will be releasing our 1.3 update which will include:

World 3: The Puttazon jungle! 🌴[list]
[*]6 beach & 4 Jungle levels
[*]9 bonus mini-levels
[*]2 adorable new Putty (Pink & Purple)
[*]A new soundtrack for the new world 🎵

As well as!

[*]Added Italian and Spanish languages 🗺
[*]Environmental art additions 🎨
[*]Better optimisation 🚀
[*]New achievements 🏆
[/list]

So grab your pal 🤝 It’s time to team up to tackle another adventure! 🚩

[h1][b]Your pals,
HG 😄[/b][h1] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27757755/52d6f9863a10c35c845f90cf3eff97a2564b6821.png[/img]

notes.title: Putty Pals Is Coming To The Nintendo Switch!!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Hey Pals! 👋[/b][/h1]

We’re ridiculously pumped to announce that PUTTY PALS IS COMING TO THE NINTENDO SWITCH!! 🎉🎉🎉

That’s right, you read correctly, we are coming to the newest and most social console ever [b]THIS SUMMER![/b] ☀️😲

notes.title: Post Launch Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b] Successful Launch!	[/b][/h1]

[i]Putty Pals’[/i] launch on Steam has been received with positive gusto!

We are so grateful to you all for having bought, played, and positively reviewed the game in our first week.

It has been amazing to see the game played by our [i]Putty Pals[/i] around the world, and we look forward to reaching more and more people in the future!
 
[h1][b] Review & Share With Friends!	[/b][/h1]

If you loved your experience playing [i]Putty Pals[/i] please Review it on our Steam Store page and help our ratings soar so we can make new Pals. Share with friends and family and let’s build this brand new Putty network!

Share your Putt-erific moments with us on Facebook and Twitter (#PuttyPals)! We’d love to see your crazy teamwork acrobatic skillz.
 
[h1][b] Exciting Updates Coming Soon…	[/b][/h1]

We have exciting stuff coming very soon and we can’t wait to share the news with you all! Keep your eyes peeled and watch this Putty space…
 
[b]Your Pals,
HG[/b]
